tools.name: rodin_create_uploads
tools.title: Create Rodin image or animation uploads
tools.description: Create one-hour presigned PUT URLs for one batch of reference images or FBX animations. kind defaults to image: 1-5 images, at most 20 MiB each, for rodin_generate.reference_upload_ids or rodin_generate_agentic.reference_upload_ids. Use kind=animation for 1-10 FBX files, at most 25 MiB each, for rodin_generate_rigging.animation_upload_ids. Each FBX must contain exactly one animation clip (Take). Upload each file successfully before passing its ID to generation. If you cannot complete the HTTP PUT uploads, explain the limitation to the user in their language and suggest continuing at https://hyper3d.ai. In ChatGPT Chat mode, also suggest trying Work mode.

tools.name: rodin_generate
tools.title: Generate a Rodin 3D model
tools.description: Use this tool for text-only generation or image-based subjects whose defining geometry is not well suited to procedural n-gons modeling, such as detailed sculpted characters, garments, or realistic car bodies. Prefer rodin_generate_agentic for subjects with clear geometric construction, even when the image shows a single, clear object. For multi-view collages or design concept sheets, first crop the relevant views locally into separate reference images with one clear subject per image, or use rodin_generate_agentic directly; image layout alone does not determine the best tool. Start a Rodin Gen-2.5 generation from a non-empty prompt, one or more reference images, or both. At least one of prompt or reference_upload_ids is required. texture_delight defaults to false; setting it to true is recommended when reference images contain highly reflective surfaces. This consumes credits. The response includes display_url; present that URL only after the generation completes. If this call times out, do not retry it automatically; ask the user to check Hyper3D Mine.

prompt.description: A non-empty text description. Required when reference_upload_ids is omitted.

reference_upload_ids.description: One to five uploaded reference image IDs. Required when prompt is omitted.

texture_delight.description: Enable texture de-lighting. Defaults to false; recommended when reference images contain highly reflective surfaces.

quality_override.description: Target polygon count. Raw accepts 500 to 1,000,000; Quad accepts 1,000 to 50,000.

tools.name: rodin_generate_bang
tools.title: Generate BANG from a Rodin generation
tools.description: Split a completed Rodin generation into parts with BANG. Pass the generation_id returned by rodin_generate as asset_id. This consumes credits. The response includes display_url; present that URL only after the BANG generation completes. If this call times out, do not retry it automatically; ask the user to check Hyper3D Mine.

asset_id.description: The generation_id returned by rodin_generate for the completed model to split.

instruction.description: Optional part-split instruction naming the parts to separate, applied to the source generation image. Omit unless the user describes which parts they want; omitting it uses the automatic split planner.

strength.description: Soft target for how many parts BANG should produce.

explode_strength.description: Guidance strength for the BANG split plan.

tools.name: rodin_get_status
tools.title: Get Rodin generation status
tools.description: Read the state of a generation. When no job records remain, downloadable model files indicate completed; otherwise the state is unknown. stage contains a user-facing name plus a 1-based current position and stable total; current is 0 before the first stage starts.

tools.name: rodin_wait
tools.title: Wait briefly for a Rodin generation
tools.description: Wait up to 45 seconds for a terminal state; unknown also ends the wait. A timeout returns the latest state and does not mean generation failed. Progress is reported as stage name/current/total, not a percentage.

tools.name: rodin_get_result
tools.title: Get Rodin model result
tools.description: Return a permanent Hyper3D result page plus temporary signed URLs for permitted Rodin output files. When presenting a link to the user, always use display_url and never expose files[].url. Only use files[].url to download a file when the user explicitly asks.

tools.name: rodin_generate_agentic
tools.title: Generate a 3D model with Agentic mode
tools.description: Prefer this tool for subjects whose defining shapes, proportions, and negative spaces can be expressed with editable n-gons and procedural construction using primitives, extrusions, profiles, sweeps, repetition, or booleans, such as simple furniture, geometric props, and robots made of separate housings and uniform links. Judge the geometry rather than the category: hard-surface objects are not always easy, and organic objects are not always unsuitable. Detailed figurative sculpting, fitted anatomical shells, tension-shaped soft assemblies, garments, and realistic car bodies are generally better suited to rodin_generate. Accepts ordinary single-subject images as well as multi-view collages and design concept sheets; these layouts alone do not guarantee suitability. Agentic mode is beta: reference fidelity and structural results may fall short of expectations. Explain these limitations to the user before submitting. Automatically choose the Rodin high-poly or Agentic n-gons pipeline from 1-5 reference images and export the final model. First upload images with rodin_create_uploads and HTTP PUT, then pass their IDs. An omitted or blank prompt is derived from the images. This consumes credits. Use rodin_get_status or rodin_wait to track completion, then rodin_get_result for downloads. If status is unknown, stop waiting and check rodin_get_result; do not resubmit automatically. Present display_url only after completion. If submission times out, do not retry automatically; ask the user to check Hyper3D Mine.

tools.name: rodin_generate_rigging
tools.title: Rig and animate a Rodin model
tools.description: Generate a skeleton and skinning for an existing Rodin model, optionally adding stock or uploaded FBX animations. Reuses confirmed geometry and textures. Exports Basic (2K) textures with All materials when confirmed textures exist, otherwise no materials. This consumes credits and creates a new generation_id. Use rodin_get_status or rodin_wait, then rodin_get_result for downloads. Present display_url only after completion. If this call times out, do not retry it automatically; ask the user to check Hyper3D Mine.

tools.name: rodin_list_animation_presets
tools.title: List Rodin rigging animation presets
tools.description: Discover built-in Rodin rigging animations. Without category, returns only categories. With category, returns only animations containing the preset IDs for that category. Use the exact returned IDs when selecting presets. Categories group the animation catalog; they do not guarantee compatibility with a skeleton template. This reads the preset catalog only and does not generate or modify models or consume credits.
